description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants to score whether their AI coach sounds like them. Sent with 1 to 20 real student questions, it answers each (Phorme's model, under a spending cap) and returns a round. Sent with that round_id and one mark per answer (true if it sounds like the coach), with confirmation, it saves the score. Show the coach every answer before they mark it; never mark for them.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

confirmation.description: True only after the coach marked every answer themselves. Needed to save marks.

marks.description: One per answer, in order: true if it sounds like the coach.

questions.description: Real student questions. Sent to start a round.

round_id.description: The round to score. Sent with marks.

name: rate_my_coach
title: Rate my coach
